# Code quality audits

<!-- Generated by agent-audit -Init from .agent-audit/. Edit those files and rerun it. -->

The [agent-audit](https://github.com/straussna/agent-audit) plugin writes its reports here. Its
lens guide and vocabulary describe each audit type, the metrics and the finding terms.

Run it from the repository root:

```powershell
./audit.ps1                  # the default modes at HEAD
./audit.ps1 -Modes <mode>    # one mode
./audit.ps1 -Modes meta      # the second phase, after the primaries' findings are committed
```

`audit.ps1` runs the plugin checkout it names and passes every flag through to the plugin's driver.

| Mode | Lens | Score marker | Lens defined in |
|---|---|---|---|
| `patterns` | patterns | Patterns Score | plugin |
| `coupling` | coupling | Coupling Score | plugin |
| `simplicity` | simplicity | Simplicity Score | plugin |
| `typing` | typing | Typing Score | plugin |
| `testing` | testing | Coverage Score | plugin |
| `guardrails` | guardrails, scoped to `harness.py`, `experiment.py`, `product.py`, `providers`, `interaction`, `view.py`, `human.py`, `Dockerfile`, `config.toml` | Guardrails Score | plugin |
| `docs` | docs | Docs Score | plugin |
| `meta` | meta | Meta-Audit Score | plugin |

This repository's audit settings live in [`.agent-audit/`](../.agent-audit/):

| Path | Holds |
|---|---|
| `config.json` | modes, paths and pack settings |
| `overlays/` | guidance added to a lens's brief: `coupling.md`, `docs.md`, `guardrails.md`, `patterns.md`, `simplicity.md`, `testing.md` |

Reports, ledgers and precompute digests are untracked. `.scores.tsv` and each mode's
`.last-audited-commit` are tracked.
